_README: Explicit (Style|Colour) -> media position maps for correcting products that predate the
publisher. Positions are 1-based in GALLERY order, matching what 253gear-align-media.js prints.
🔴 NEVER infer these from filenames. Two of Spanaway's four photos are named 34082 while the
design is 34084, and Calico Cat's lifestyle shots carry generic stock filenames with no colour
in them at all. A wrong map silently sells the wrong colour.
productLevel declares what an UNBOUND image should inherit. The theme gives an unbound photo
the options of the nearest preceding bound photo (product-template.CURRENT.liquid:393-402), so
the script simulates that walk and refuses to run if the declared value disagrees with the
position. That is the check that stops a lifestyle photo switching the shopper's colour.
